notes: Large step up. Snow reads as snow, pine has real needle clumps and two-tone bark.

defects.text: Snow spruce now clearly snow-laden with green showing through.
Pine crown now dense needle clumps; still flat layered pads with a narrow outline.
Pine bark: grey-brown low, orange above, trunk bent.
Spruce dense conical; leader still a dark thin spike.
Roots fixed but the sits-on-ground warning remains: lowest point is still -0.91 m.
Lowest spruce whorls (start z 1.6 m, 3.9 m long, sag 0.32) droop to z = -0.9 m: branch tips pass through the ground.
defects.fix: Start whorls at z 2.0, lower elevation bias -0.14, sag 0.24.

defects.text: Pine pads are flat horizontal layers; crown needs rounder outline; spruce leader is thin.
defects.fix: Bias pine cards upward, add leader/top clump to pine; widen spruce leader.
